payload_sha: SHA256(all bytes following catalog header, including finalized entry_id)
code_and_rodata_offsets: relative to the separate program container; schema offset is relative to catalog start
reloc_count: total typed schema rule count, including scalars and reserved zeros
files: root-owned regular files, no group/other write, opened with O_NOFOLLOW
update: empty device with no owner or references; provider retains private bytes for lifetime
trust: administrator controlled code, not an untrusted GPU code sandbox
hardware_declaration: full provider identity; not independent measurement of loaded PL
working_set_note: catalog entries do not promise simultaneous residency; fixed-PC programs require prior completed/retired unload before another overlapping code allocation
